note.kid: Only {yours} and the server have the key.
note.nerd: Encrypted and authenticated end to end.

sealed.kid: Locked. Nobody on the way can read what’s inside.
sealed.nerd: Ciphertext: intermediate hops can’t read it, or change it without being caught.

line: Transport Layer Security: Application Data, length {length}

type.name: Content type
type.about: 23 = encrypted application data (the handshake is over).

version.name: Version
version.about: Always 0x0303 on application data, even in TLS 1.3 (kept for old middleboxes).

length.name: Length
length.about: Bytes of ciphertext that follow: the payload, its 1-byte real content type and the 16-byte authentication tag.
